$comment: S9b's answer for one review row (design §9; plan WP-20 done-when 2): each of the row's six Korean reason fields (stage_propose.REASON_FIELDS, the Korean the owner reads; the flat proposal's singular `reason` is a copy of `reasons.reason`) judged against the row's English payload for faithfulness and plain wording. Code holds the field set to the six, each once, and the verdict to the fields: `pass` exactly when every field is both faithful and plain.
title: S9b review of a row's Korean

verdict.$comment: Two values: a row either reads as its payload says, plainly, or it is regenerated once.

faithful.$comment: No fact of the payload dropped, none added, no condition or exception lost, no claim made stronger or weaker.

plain.$comment: A person new to the work can follow it: plain words, a technical term explained where it first appears.
